Title: uTPro GeoLocation - IP-based Visitor Country Detection
Description: Detects the visitor's country from CDN headers (Cloudflare CF-IPCountry, AWS CloudFront-Viewer-Country, Azure Front Door) with an offline MMDB fallback (iplocate.io). Maps country codes to .NET CultureInfo for multi-language Umbraco sites. Pluggable provider chain, configurable culture mapping, cookie persistence, and optional auto-culture middleware. Works with Umbraco 16, 17 and 18.
